pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
**Bubba G’s got the grind squad, but Ghost Pepper’s lookin’ to turn up the heat in Texas.**

Alright, folks, we’ve got ourselves a real clash comin’ up in Arlington: France takin’ on Spain. Bubba G’s sittin’ pretty at the top of the standings 'cause he’s been relyin’ on France to put in some serious work. Devin, the Ghost Pepper, is right on his tail, ridin’ that Spanish flair like he’s tryin’ to impress the waitstaff at a tapas bar. You gotta love Bubba G thinkin' draftin' DR Congo was a mastermind play, but I reckon his barber's got a better shot at cuttin' prime rib than cuttin' goals. Devin’s got all the spice with Spain and the USA, though he probably picked Haiti thinkin’ he was goin’ for the hottest underdog—turns out they’re more like a mild salsa. My money’s on Devin pullin’ out a stunner here; Ghost Pepper’s about to bring the fire and singe France’s baguettes. Write home to momma, Bubba G’s goin’ down!
